# UP2CLOUD

> Principal Cloud Architecture and FinOps consultancy led by Cesar Augusto Nogueira.
> Specializes in multi-cloud architecture, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and cloud cost

## About

UP2CLOUD is an independent consultancy founded in 2022 by Cesar Augusto Nogueira, a
principal-level cloud architect with 10+ years of experience. Services span:

- Multi-cloud architecture (GCP, AWS, Azure)
- Platform Engineering and Kubernetes
- FinOps and cloud cost optimization
- DevOps, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
- Cloud migration and governance
